whatsNewMissingBody: The summary for this version isn't available here. The full notes are in the changelog.
whatsNewHint: Reopen these notes anytime in Settings › Version & updates.
whatsNewSettingDesc: Reopen the release summary shown the first time Kun starts after an update.
whatsNewFocusTitle: Hide the Kun logo and account card
whatsNewFocusBody: Turn it on and the swimming Kun logo, the sidebar account card, conversation avatars and Kun animations step aside, leaving just the conversation.
whatsNewFocusWhere: Switch it anytime with Focus at the bottom of the sidebar
whatsNewArtifactsTitle: Everything Kun makes, in one place
whatsNewArtifactsBody: Design drafts, documents, slides, spreadsheets, whiteboards and generated images, sorted by project and type. Open one to preview it, or ask Kun to revise it in its conversation.
whatsNewArtifactsWhere: Find it anytime under Artifacts in the sidebar
